description: Create and inspect a Mac worksheet chart for the calling cell.
declarations: Dim testSheet As Worksheet, oldActiveSheet As Object
Dim oldFormula As Variant, pictureType As Long, pictureVisibility As Long
Dim macPicture As Shape, cleanupPicture As Shape, pictureMetadata As String, plotted As Variant
check: CStr(result) = "Chart" And pictureType = msoPicture And pictureVisibility = msoFalse And Left$(pictureMetadata, Len("SMFCommentPicture/1" & vbLf & "J20" & vbLf)) = "SMFCommentPicture/1" & vbLf & "J20" & vbLf
expected_text: Chart result and a newly embedded Mac picture tied to J20, with the requested hidden state.
result_details: "Mac Shape.Type=" & CStr(pictureType) & "; Visible=" & CStr(pictureVisibility) & "; Metadata=" & pictureMetadata
cleanup: If Not cleanupPicture Is Nothing Then
If Left$(cleanupPicture.AlternativeText, Len("SMFCommentPicture/1" & vbLf)) = "SMFCommentPicture/1" & vbLf Then cleanupPicture.Delete
coverage_note: Mac stores the chart as an embedded worksheet object with a basic text note; the cell menu controls visibility. This checks object type, ownership and visibility, without Comment.Shape.Fill. HTTP diagnostics describe the last SMF data request, not this image.

description: Fetch Yahoo AAPL expirations with fifty output rows and format the first expiration as an AAPL $350 call; compare with the original four-row case.
declarations: Dim liveOptionsOldKeys(1 To kPages) As String
Dim liveOptionsOldBodies(1 To kPages) As String
Dim liveOptionsOldSData(1 To 3) As String
Dim liveOptionsIndex As Long
Dim liveOptionsOldCacheMode As String
Dim liveOptionsOldLog As String
Dim liveOptionsOldError As Variant
check: (IsArray(result) And UBound(result, 1) = 50 And UBound(result, 2) = 1 And Left$(CStr(ArrayCell(result, 1, 1)), 5) = "AAPL " And InStr(1, CStr(ArrayCell(result, 1, 1)), "$350.00 Call", vbBinaryCompare) > 0) And SMFMacHTTPStatus() = 200
expected_text: At least one available AAPL $350 Call expiration and HTTP200; the function has no expiration-date filter
coverage_note: Actual provider request: no response fixture is seeded. The SMF page cache is cleared for this case, reused only within the call, and restored afterward. This metadata describes a planned live case; execution_status remains not_run until the native harness records a result. Fifty rows match the Yahoo branch maximum write loop. The existing four-row probe remains unchanged to expose the bounds defect if the source supplies more than four expirations.
